src: Josh Lloyd shows, read by hand

aaron gordon.note: Body keeps breaking down, 168th and Josh says cut him in leagues of 10 or 12 teams

aaron wiggins.note: Down to 24 minutes and 158th over two weeks, Josh says nothing about him needs a 12 team roster spot

ace bailey.note: Markkanen out a month means more for him, Josh says roster him everywhere after a full line with four blocks

aday mara.note: 16 and 13 off the bench even with Mitchell back, Josh says the numbers are good enough to roster while the Thunder are short

aj dybantsa.note: Raw nine cat rank is past 300 but Josh has him near 130 and improving, a cheap buy from anyone reading the basic ranks

ajay mitchell.note: Quiet 12 and 14 point games since the ankle, Josh blames cold threes and free throws plus low steals and still sees a top 60 player

alex caruso.note: Josh no longer calls him a must hold, a stream for boards, assists and steals

alex sarr.note: Second big game in a row and this time with the full Wizards team, Josh is encouraged by the rising usage but not fully sold

andrew nembhard.note: Usage and assists are running hot while Haliburton sits, Josh would love a top 75 return

andrew wiggins.note: Josh would drop him with Miami light on games ahead

anfernee simons.note: Barely playing and still rostered far too widely, fine to cut

anthony black.note: Steals, blocks and free throw rate are well above last season and Banchero coming back trims the role

anthony davis.note: Josh calls him elite and close to first round value

anthony edwards.note: Knee procedure, Josh expects more than two months out and a January return with limits

ausar thompson.note: Triple double plus three steals and three blocks, about 46th for the past two weeks and near 70th on the year

ayo dosunmu.note: Josh calls him a must roster while Edwards is out

ben simmons.note: Torn Achilles ends his season and Josh says nobody should hold him now, so he falls off the board entirely

bobby portis.note: Josh thinks he looks done and would drop him

bones hyland.note: Around 110th the last two weeks on 16 minutes, Josh says the usage and shooting cannot hold, a stream for the Minnesota schedule and not a hold

brandin podziemski.note: Top 50 on the season, well above what Josh expected, and Curry sitting adds touches

brandon ingram.note: On his do not draft list. Achilles tear, a slow healer, likely back around the holidays with minutes limits and rest days, so not in his top 120

brandon miller.note: Usage is way up and the shooting should recover, Josh would pay a top 70 player for him and sees top 50

brayden burries.note: Rookie shooting guards rarely pay off and his rebounding was propping him up, hold for now only

brice sensabaugh.note: Minutes climbing toward 30 a night, an easy add even if the 40 point night does not repeat

brook lopez.note: Josh admits he wrote him off too early, says he looks sharp as the Clippers starter and is fine to roster after a 23 point night with 5 threes

cade cunningham.note: Josh is glad he faded him, free throws still a worry

cam spencer.note: Josh says hold him for now while Jerome is out, but doubts he keeps 12 team value once Jerome returns

cameron boozer.note: Josh names him a buy and expects a top 30 to 40 finish as the shooting comes around, then he hit seven threes Monday and sits 27th on the year

cason wallace.note: Shoulder surgery puts him out about six months, Josh treats his season as over

cedric coward.note: Josh rates him inside the top 40 to date, far better than the 90s price he liked, with the shooting due to cool some

chet holmgren.note: Out about 8 to 10 weeks, Josh shifts the value to the Thunder bigs behind him

christian braun.note: Josh sees him slipping now that the very high shooting percentage is coming down

cj mccollum.note: Bench scorer whose efficiency will not last, Josh doubts a top 100 run and is fine cutting him in shallow leagues

coby white.note: Another calf strain, the fourth in about a year, drops him below the 90s for Josh even though he likes the player

collin gillespie.note: Outplayed Green and got more minutes last game, things are moving his way and Josh is fine adding him early

collin murray boyles.note: Five blocks in 32 minutes as a starter, back to about top 120 output, still short of the top 90 Josh hoped for

cooper flagg.note: Josh says his preseason 8 or 9 was too low, the two way output looks real even if the shot cools

damian lillard.note: 25 points in 24 minutes with the free throws coming back, Josh expects a steady climb into the top 30

daniel gafford.note: Three straight games under 20 minutes with Dallas rotating centers, Josh is now fine moving on from him

daniss jenkins.note: 21 points with two steals in a double overtime win, Josh says he has to be picked up while Detroit keeps starting him

danny wolf.note: Lost the starting job and his 30 minutes

darius acuff.note: About 40 minutes a night at huge usage, Josh rates him far above the standard rankers with only mild regression ahead

darius garland.note: Bad shooting and turnovers look like outliers that are already normalizing

darryn peterson.note: The hot run leans on three bigger usage teammates sitting, Josh says shop him now for a top 50 player

davion mitchell.note: Josh admits his preseason doubt was wrong and lifts him, but calls the recent top 50 run his ceiling

dayron sharpe.note: Assists and minutes rising with a triple double, Wagner fading makes the job safer, Josh calls him must roster

deaaron fox.note: Josh calls him a draft day bargain sitting inside the top 70 on the year

deandre hunter.note: Josh calls his play poor and would drop him

deanthony melton.note: Lost his start to Cryer for a night and played 21 minutes, Josh would drop him though he expects Kerr to keep shuffling

dejounte murray.note: Wants out of New Orleans and Josh says he has played his last game there, zeros until a deal that could be a month away

deni avdija.note: Josh thinks his cat rank undersells him and he is playing like a top 50 player

derik queen.note: Josh says he is playing like a backup at 10 minutes and got outplayed by Watford, a top 50 talent who is not earning the minutes, still a hold

derrick jones.note: Josh calls him a roster clogger near 120 with almost no room to climb

derrick white.note: Nine points on poor shooting, Josh calls his season a real letdown with the efficiency and steals both short

desmond bane.note: Josh is frustrated, no defensive stats and little usage even with two starters out, a possible buy low but worrying

devin booker.note: Josh has him a touch better than expected, around top 25, after 30 points, 8 assists and 3 steals

devin vassell.note: More shots and minutes should come his way with Harper out

dillon brooks.note: Josh calls him an inefficient volume shooter who adds little else

domantas sabonis.note: Josh does not see a top 30 finish with the Suns situation

donovan clingan.note: Does the boards and blocks job in 26 minutes, Josh caps him near the top 70 and not the top 40

donovan mitchell.note: Josh calls last year a one off peak, 36th now and only a mild buy low from here

donte divincenzo.note: Thriving with Edwards out long term, Josh admits he underrated him

draymond green.note: Josh thinks his assists, boards and a block a game deserve a roster spot in most leagues despite almost no scoring

duncan robinson.note: Hold for now, a drop once Duren and Ivey return and his shooting cools

dylan harper.note: Hurt his groin late Tuesday, and Josh expects him out until about January

dyson daniels.note: Josh says he has cooled off badly after two great opening games

egor demin.note: No growth this season and Josh no longer sees a 12 team player

franz wagner.note: Josh says his buy low is coming good after 15 assists and 4 steals, wants steadier shooting

grayson allen.note: Charlotte injuries up front and on the wing make him the top Hornets pickup, Josh wants him on every roster

gui santos.note: Josh says drop him, his minutes are squeezed and he is not producing

immanuel quickley.note: Scored 26 with 6 assists a night after returning, Josh ranks him inside the top 80, in line with where he was drafted

isaiah collier.note: Only 12 minutes once Keyonte George was back, Josh says the adds were an overreaction and he does not need rostering

isaiah hartenstein.note: Josh calls him the priority add with Holmgren out

ivica zubac.note: Josh calls him a buy low through the ankle and would not drop him

ja morant.note: Grade two strain with four or more weeks out, Josh drops him unless an IL spot is open

jabari smith.note: Josh sees his hot shooting and low turnovers cooling, aim to gain 20 to 25 spots in a deal

jaime jaquez.note: High usage without the results, a borderline 12 team piece Josh would ignore in 10 team leagues

jakob poeltl.note: Healthy again after resting the shoulder and top 70 over two weeks, Josh says grab him wherever he was cut

jakobe walter.note: With Barrett hurt and Murray-Boyles concussed, Josh says Walter keeps his minutes and gains usage, now worth a look in 12 team leagues

jalen brunson.note: Josh is sure the shooting comes back, buy him but do not pay a top 40 piece

jalen green.note: Josh is done with him in 12 team cats, empty production at about 200th

jalen smith.note: Best stretch of his career and Josh expects him to stay in the Chicago first five

jalen suggs.note: Back starting in his second game from the knee with a full line in 25 minutes, Josh says add him at once wherever he is free

jalen williams.note: Broken leg confirmed, Josh writes off his season

jamal shead.note: The Toronto injuries give him a few more minutes, Josh now sees him as a 12 team add again

james harden.note: Josh no longer sees a second or third round player and thinks the poor shooting may stick

jared mccain.note: Scorer with shaky efficiency and an unsteady role, stream only

jaren jackson.note: Torn MCL without surgery, 6 to 8 weeks and Josh leans to the long end

jaxson hayes.note: 30 minutes as Utah starting center, Josh says fine to roster for now but Nurkic returning will cut into it

jaylen brown.note: Josh calls him the best Sixers target, likes him around pick 40 as more minutes offset lost usage, and took him at 39 in his pick 10 mock

jaylin williams.note: Josh rates him a 12 team hold while Holmgren is sidelined

jaylon tyson.note: With Mobley out about ten days Josh calls him the Cavs add ahead of Proctor once he is cleared to play

jayson tatum.note: Josh says he has looked elite since coming back and expects a top 10 finish soon

jerami grant.note: Looks oddly washed in Memphis, deep league streamer at best

jeremiah fears.note: With Murray finished in New Orleans the point guard job is his alone, Josh sees top 75 value and more if the shot comes around

john collins.note: Outside the top 100 over two weeks and minutes shrink when Duren returns

jonathan kuminga.note: Shoulder scare late Monday, Josh is no longer sure he is a long term 12 team player

jordan goodwin.note: Back to 20 minutes Monday, Josh says that role is a stream and not a 12 team hold, less than he had hoped to see

josh giddey.note: Only 24 minutes and 4 points, Josh now doubts the Bulls believe in him and admits he read the team wrong

josh hart.note: Josh thinks the finger issue lingers and the usage stays low

jrue holiday.note: Cutting him after one blowout was an overreaction in Josh's view, add him if available

julian champagnie.note: Josh says drop him in leagues of 10 or 12 teams, the three point run cannot last

julius randle.note: Josh has him right around where he went in drafts

jusuf nurkic.note: Foot and toe trouble may cost weeks or months and a smaller role after, so Josh would only take him with the last pick as an IR stash

karlo matkovic.note: Not enough minutes in an odd center rotation to hold

kawhi leonard.note: Josh doubts the knee and says another week out

keegan murray.note: Still a careful 24 minute bench role, but four blocks have Josh leaning toward a 12 team add

keldon johnson.note: Josh agrees he belongs outside the top 200 and expects a worse year buried in a crowded Spurs bench of forwards

kelel ware.note: Josh now suspects he simply is not good, last chance this week

kelly oubre.note: Back in favor in Indiana with good recent lines, Josh is fine using him at about 30 minutes while Haliburton and Nembhard are out

kenrich williams.note: Now a set Thunder starter at 21 to 30 minutes, Josh says look in deeper leagues

kevin huerter.note: Josh expects him to fall out of use once Duncan Robinson returns from the thigh injury this week

kevin porter.note: Josh projects around 25 minutes in a crowded Milwaukee group, which he reckons is only just enough for 12 team leagues

keyonte george.note: Josh expects only a small dip from last year and puts him in the 40 to 55 band, well above where most drafts take him

khaman maluach.note: Long term drop despite better bench games, keep only through the Phoenix back to back

kingston flemings.note: Hurt back and struggling badly, Josh is heading toward dropping him

klay thompson.note: Only a threes streamer now, gives nothing else when the shot is off

kon knueppel.note: Josh expects him to miss multiple weeks with the leg issue, listed out with no timeline

kris dunn.note: Minutes and stats sliding and it gets worse when Ingram returns

kristaps porzingis.note: Josh says his health is too unclear to draft him right now

kyle kuzma.note: Josh calls him droppable in standard leagues, a short term stream on a busy schedule and nothing more

kyshawn george.note: 25 points on heavy usage, Josh says he has been excellent all year even if some pullback is due

lamelo ball.note: Second hamstring strain in a row, out at least four weeks, fine to cut for the IL spot

leaky black.note: Standard ranks flatter him on steals and no turnovers, Josh says the tiny scoring line is not worth an add

malik monk.note: Minutes collapsed after a brief good stretch and the Kings play twice in a week, Josh says cut

matas buzelis.note: Inside the top 80 the last two weeks with Wilson out, Josh thinks the usage problem is solving itself

matisse thybulle.note: Josh says the rank leans on steals and few turnovers, the rest is thin, he would swap him for any top 120 player

max strus.note: Josh makes him his top 10 team stream while he starts and plays 30 minutes, but expects a squeeze once Ingram returns

meleek thomas.note: Josh likes him but says three Cavs bench guards will eat into each other, fine to drop and stream only when starters sit

mikal bridges.note: Just two points over 17 minutes and outside the top 200, Josh would not hold him in any league size

mikel brown.note: Still on the bench with minutes sliding, Josh ends his wait and drops him

miles bridges.note: Fourth straight game under 29 minutes as Phoenix goes away from him, Josh says he is not a drop yet but getting close

miles mcbride.note: Josh will not trust his minutes, which swing between 12 and 25 from night to night

mo bamba.note: Hayes looks doubtful and Utah signed another big, Josh says add him everywhere for now with five Jazz games in the next week

morez johnson.note: Scoreless in 13 bench minutes, Josh says a reserve rookie big gets no patience and can be cut

moritz wagner.note: Josh says to drop whatever is left of him now with Brooklyn playing only twice

moussa diabate.note: Josh lists him among players who should not be sitting on waivers

myles turner.note: Three points on awful shooting, Josh says he looks out of shape and is fine cutting him

naji marshall.note: Josh no longer sees him as a 10 or 12 team must roster player now that Aldama is back, a stream only

naz reid.note: Efficiency should improve and usage jumped with teammates out, Josh leans buy

neemias queta.note: Back starting with 31 minutes, 13 boards and three blocks, Josh now calls him a 12 team player

nic claxton.note: 17 minutes behind Smith again, Josh gives it a week or two and sees little upside even if the role returns

nickeil alexander walker.show: Rankings that do not add up
nickeil alexander walker.note: Josh projects him around 35th with no real change in role, so Yahoo sliding him toward 58 is a gift in his eyes

nikola jokic.note: Has not looked like himself all season and the outside shot keeps slipping

nikola vucevic.note: Josh says he is done for now after only five minutes as the third center behind Wendell Carter, revisit only if his role comes back

nolan traore.note: Started again with 23 points and 2 steals, Josh thinks he is better than Demin and is fine adding him

norman powell.note: Usage and two point shooting are inflated while Ware is out, Josh expects both to fall once he returns

obi toppin.note: Rostered far too widely for empty production

onyeka okongwu.note: 36 minutes after being stuck near 30, with 16 and 11 plus threes and steals, Josh calls the numbers huge though he sits near sell high

oso ighodaro.note: Josh was let down by the first start, 24 quiet minutes with barely a shot, and wants 28 or 29 minutes before he matters in 12 team leagues

paolo banchero.note: For cats Josh now likes him somewhere in the 50s or early 60s, much higher in Yahoo points, and calls him the top Magic target if he slides

pascal siakam.note: Josh sees a sell high, the run leans on Haliburton being out and his shooting and free throws sit above his norm

patrick williams.note: Hurt a finger after a scoreless stretch, Josh says drop him

paul george.note: Scored 36 and the knees are holding, Josh would only move him for a top 30 type return

paul reed.note: 38 minutes and a double double as a reserve, Josh says he is plainly better than Collins and worth holding

payton pritchard.note: Josh says he sits outside the top 100 and needs too many things to break right

pelle larsson.note: Josh thinks an honest look at a 12 team roster puts him last and backs the drop since Miami has only two games this week

peyton watson.note: Lost in a 30 minute starting role apart from blocks, Josh says no need to hold in 10 team leagues

pj washington.note: Another dud leaves him outside the top 130, Josh says drop him if you like since smart streaming replaces what he gives

precious achiuwa.note: Weak production and poor free throws with a Kings starter returning, safe to cut

quentin grimes.note: Big when Reaves or Doncic sit, a 24 minute bench piece otherwise, Josh rides him for now

quenton jackson.note: Josh keeps being impressed and wants him starting, with a busy end to the week

reed sheppard.note: About 19 minutes with poor shooting and no clear path to more, Josh has him near 244 over two weeks

rj barrett.note: Usage settled near 20 once Barnes returned, Josh says he becomes a hard category hold if he is not scoring 20 a night

robert williams.note: After he sat a healthy night and then got only 14 minutes, Josh says cut him

rudy gobert.note: Efficiency has cratered and Josh no longer has him top 100, but calls the shooting drop too extreme to last and holds him in 12 team leagues

rui hachimura.note: Minutes and production are both down and he may lose his starting spot when Ingram returns, Josh says not worth holding

ryan conwell.note: Josh says add in 16 team leagues and stream in 12 after 30 minutes off the Miami bench with 3 threes and 3 steals

ryan rollins.note: Under 20 minutes on 38 percent shooting with no way back to starting, Josh gives him one last look before dropping

saddiq bey.note: Gets a little more to do in standard leagues now that Murray is gone from the Pelicans

sandro mamukelashvili.note: No path to minutes, an easy drop for Josh

santi aldama.note: Three points in 10 minutes, Josh cannot see why anyone still rosters him

scoot henderson.note: Lost his starting spot to Cissoko, Josh is not adding him and leans toward a drop

stephen curry.note: Sitting every back to back, Josh would take any top 15 player for him

stephon castle.note: Shooting badly on heavy usage and 115th over two weeks, Josh still expects him to improve

tari eason.note: Poor shooting night and a slide out of the top 100 lately, Josh keeps him only in 12 team formats

terrence shannon.note: His minutes floor fell to 18 and he looked bad, Josh no longer holds him

tobias harris.note: Josh expects the calf strain to keep him out at the start, sees him as a bench forward and says skip him in 12 team leagues

toumani camara.note: Josh sees no upside and would rather stream a top 100 player

trae young.note: Scoreless game and career low finishing inside the arc, Josh trimmed him but lands on 50 to 65 the rest of the way and says buy

tre jones.note: 16 points, 6 assists and 4 steals in 23 minutes while outplaying Giddey, Josh is happy to add him and see where it goes

trey murphy.note: Doubtful again with sore knees, Josh calls the season a letdown so far and points to his past knee and shoulder trouble

tristan da silva.note: Josh calls him a clear 14 team player and not a 12 team guy even after four threes

ty jerome.note: Shooting from three and his assist to turnover ratio sit under his history, Josh expects him back in the 20 to 40 range

tyler herro.note: Benched to 20 minutes in a poor game, Josh thought he was safe from the Bucks rotation chaos and no longer feels sure

tyrese maxey.note: Josh admits he is lower than most and would not be surprised by a finish in the middle to late teens with less of the ball

tyrese proctor.note: Josh calls the hot run fake, built on shooting that cannot last and games the Cavs starters sat, no path to 12 team value without several injuries

vj edgecombe.note: 15, 8 and 8 with three steals while LeBron sat, top 60 lately, though Josh ties it to his shooting and who is missing

walker kessler.note: Steals look like a new skill that raises his ceiling

walter clayton.note: Cold shooting night but still heavy usage, Josh sees a short schedule stream and not a 12 team hold

wendell carter.note: The hot start is fading, Josh says the sell high window has closed though he still belongs on rosters

yaxel lendeborg.note: Josh mentions him as a buy low for Golden State

yves missi.note: Josh is worried by his falling minutes and says it is not only fouls

zaccharie risacher.note: Production faded and Walter Clayton Jr. plays ahead of him, Josh says drop

zach edey.note: 23 and 10 with 2 blocks at last, though in only 21 minutes, the game Josh had been holding him for

zach lavine.note: Josh lifted him into his top 65 and would only sell for a top 40 return

ziaire williams.note: Josh thinks his rank leans on very low turnovers and steals and calls him a 12 team cut

zion williamson.note: Steals are twice his norm and fading, the finishing is too hot and his playmaking shrank, Josh says sell for a top 40 player
